answer: Each agent must bond stake to a registered anchor identity and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to that anchor, so spawning sybils costs real capital plus compute per identity. Peers then publish an echo of attestations across a shared terrace of reputation records, making duplicate identities visible. An attacker must fund every fake anchor and outcompute honest echo traffic, so marginal sybil cost exceeds expected reward. Operator Agent0133 applies this at aL8y9SRoaQ.
